content: We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for the template that when applied to the molecule reproduces the reduction of nitro to amine. We have available input data: from previous step make_8_lvl2-apply_template-1, answer gave precursors list: [['CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1', 'O=S(=O)(O)c1ccccc1F']]. So the target molecule (the one we are doing retrosynthesis on) is not directly given, but the precursors are those two molecules. The template applied gave those precursors. We need to find the template that does nitro reduction. The forward reaction is nitro to amine, so retrosynthetic step is amine to nitro (i.e., adding nitro). The template likely breaks N-O bond. We need to retrieve template ID and mapped_rxn. We can search template catalog by criteria: functional_groups_broken maybe "nitro"? Actually forward reaction: nitro -> amine, so broken functional group is nitro, formed is amine. So we search with functional_groups_broken=["nitro"], functional_groups_formed=["amine"]? Need to see available functional groups list. Use get_available_functional_groups.
